'''Fabio Toninelli''' (born 1975) is an Italian mathematician who works in [[probability theory]], [[stochastic process]]es and probabilistic aspects of [[mathematical physics]].

==Education==
He obtained his PhD in physics, in 2003, from [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]].

==Career==
Between 2004 and 2020 he was senior researcher at [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS)]] in Lyon. Since 2020 he has been Professor of Mathematics at [[TU Wien|Technische Universität Wien]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mathematische Stochastik : TONINELLI|url=https://institute.tuwien.ac.at/mstoch/staff/toninelli/EN/|access-date=2021-01-12|website=institute.tuwien.ac.at}}</ref>

In 2021–2024 he was co-editor-in-chief (jointly with [[Bálint Tóth]]) of the journal ''[[Probability Theory and Related Fields]]''.<ref>{{cite web
| title = Probability Theory and Related Fields editors
| url = https://link.springer.com/journal/440/editors
| access-date = 15 March 2024
| url-status = live
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20240315093717/https://link.springer.com/journal/440/editors
| archive-date = 15 March 2024}}</ref>

==Research==
Toninelli has contributed substantially to the mathematical theory of disordered [[Statistical mechanics#:~:text=Statistical mechanics is one of,large assemblies of microscopic entities.|statistical mechanical systems]], mixing of [[Markov chain]]s, dimer models. His most significant contributions concern the theory of mean-field [[spin glasses]], of polymers in random environments and of stochastic interface dynamics.

==Recognition==
Toninelli was an [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker]] of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] ICM-2018 (Rio de Janeiro),<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=ICM 2018 Rio de Janeiro|url=https://icm2018.impa.br/portal/main.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201202030636/https://icm2018.impa.br/portal/main.html|archive-date=2020-12-02|access-date=|website=|url-status=dead}}</ref> an invited plenary speaker of the 9th European Congress of Mathematics (Sevilla, 2024, https://www.ecm2024sevilla.com/), an invited plenary speaker of the [[International Congress on Mathematical Physics]] ICMP-2018 (Montreal),<ref>{{Cite web|title=Plenary Talks {{!}} ICMP 2018|url=https://icmp2018.org/prog/session/pl|access-date=2021-01-12|website=icmp2018.org}}</ref> and an invited plenary speaker of the Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications SPA-2014 (Buenos Aires).<ref>{{Cite web|title=SPA-2014 – 37th Conference on Stochastic Processes and their Applications|url=http://mate.dm.uba.ar/~probab/spa2014/|access-date=2021-01-12|website=mate.dm.uba.ar}}</ref>
